name: Endeavor: Deep Sea

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after all players pass in round 6 (round 7 in solo)

categories.label: Attribute tracks (4 tracks combined)
categories.hint: Sum the scoring bracket reached by each of the 4 track markers (brackets are printed on the player mat).

categories.label: Impact board hexes
categories.hint: Points for your markers in scoring hexes per the Scoring Legend of the scenario sheet.

categories.label: Published Journals
categories.hint: Sum of points shown on your published Journals.

categories.label: Tier-5 senior specialist
categories.hint: Scoring is unique to each tier-5 specialist; ignore remainders.

categories.label: Scenario goals
categories.hint: Sum of scenario sheet goal scores, incl. 1st/2nd place bonuses where the scenario has them (values vary per scenario).

categories.label: Leftover Research and discs
categories.hint: Research (incl. on a stored Dive token) plus discs in Staging Area, divided by 3, round down.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

notes: family: tracks-plus-scenario. Rulebook is scenario-driven: track brackets, impact legend and scenario goals differ per scenario sheet, so those are scorer inputs. Cooperative and solo modes use goal counts instead of points (not modelled): solo plays 7 rounds. Based on the Burnt Island Games rulebook PDF final scoring pages (read via text extraction, page numbers approximate).
